model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between "Coverage" and the "Number of completions ($k$)" for four different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions ($k$)" and utilizes a logarithmic scale (base 2), ranging from $2^0$ to $2^8$ with tick marks placed at every consecutive power of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and uses a linear scale, with visible tick marks at intervals of 0.2, specifically at 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. The plot contains four lines that all exhibit a steady upward trend across the x-axis. The "Llama-3B" model is represented by a solid dark blue line with circular markers, starting at a coverage value of approximately 0.43 at $2^0$ and increasing to roughly 0.91 at $2^8$. The "Llama-3B + FT" model is shown as a dotted dark green line with upward-pointing triangular markers, closely tracking the Llama-3B line from a starting value near 0.43 at $2^0$ to an ending value near 0.91 at $2^8$. The "Llama-1B" model is depicted by a solid light blue line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 0.25 at $2^0$ and rising to about 0.86 at $2^8$. Finally, the "Llama-1B + FT" model is represented by a dotted light green line with upward-pointing triangular markers, which closely follows the Llama-1B line, starting around 0.25 at $2^0$ and concluding near 0.86 at $2^8$.
